senses.ex: The office is in a nondescript grey building near the station.
senses.exPt: O escritório fica num prédio cinza sem graça perto da estação.

senses.def: not one of a group of people or things
senses.ex: I called three shops, but none of them had it.
senses.exPt: Liguei para três lojas, mas nenhuma delas tinha.

senses.def: not any of an amount of something
senses.ex: I wanted some milk, but there was none left.
senses.exPt: Eu queria leite, mas não tinha sobrado nada.

senses.def: despite what has just been said
senses.ex: The hotel was expensive, but we decided to stay there nonetheless.
senses.exPt: O hotel era caro, mas decidimos ficar lá mesmo assim.

senses.def: not doing something as a paid job
senses.ex: The play was performed by a nonprofessional cast.
senses.exPt: A peça foi encenada por um elenco amador.

senses.def: ideas or statements that are silly or not true
senses.ex: Don't talk nonsense, you're not too old to learn.
senses.exPt: Não fala bobagem, você não é velho demais para aprender.

senses.def: twelve o'clock in the middle of the day
senses.ex: Let's meet for lunch at noon.
senses.exPt: Vamos nos encontrar para almoçar ao meio-dia.

senses.def: used after a negative to add another negative
senses.ex: I don't like coffee, and nor does my sister.
senses.exPt: Eu não gosto de café, e nem a minha irmã.

senses.def: usual or ordinary; what you expect
senses.ex: It's normal to feel tired after a long trip.
senses.exPt: É normal se sentir cansado depois de uma viagem longa.

senses.def: usually, in the usual situation
senses.ex: I normally get up at seven on weekdays.
senses.exPt: Eu normalmente acordo às sete durante a semana.

senses.def: accepted standards of behaviour in a society or group
senses.ex: Every culture has its own social norms about how to greet people.
senses.exPt: Toda cultura tem suas próprias normas sociais sobre como cumprimentar as pessoas.

senses.def: the direction on your left when you face the rising sun
senses.ex: It's much colder in the north of the country.
senses.exPt: Faz muito mais frio no norte do país.

senses.def: towards the north
senses.ex: We drove north for three hours.
senses.exPt: Dirigimos para o norte por três horas.

senses.def: the direction or area between north and east
senses.ex: The town is in the northeast of the country.
senses.exPt: A cidade fica no nordeste do país.

senses.def: in or from the north-east of a place
senses.ex: She grew up in a small village in northeastern Brazil.
senses.exPt: Ela cresceu numa pequena vila do nordeste do Brasil.

senses.def: in or from the north of a place
senses.ex: They live in a small town in northern Italy.
senses.exPt: Eles moram numa cidade pequena do norte da Itália.

senses.def: towards the north
senses.ex: The birds fly northward every spring.
senses.exPt: Os pássaros voam para o norte toda primavera.

senses.def: the direction between north and west
senses.ex: The storm is coming from the northwest.
senses.exPt: A tempestade está vindo do noroeste.

senses.def: in or from the north-west of a place
senses.ex: They spent a week hiking in the mountains of northwestern Spain.
senses.exPt: Eles passaram uma semana fazendo trilha nas montanhas do noroeste da Espanha.

senses.def: the part of your face that you breathe and smell with
senses.ex: I have a cold and my nose is red.
senses.exPt: Estou resfriado e meu nariz está vermelho.

senses.def: one of the two openings in your nose
senses.ex: Breathe in slowly through your nostrils.
senses.exPt: Inspire devagar pelas narinas.

senses.def: used to make a sentence negative
senses.ex: I'm not hungry right now.
senses.exPt: Não estou com fome agora.

senses.def: important or interesting enough to get attention
senses.ex: The most notable change is the new camera.
senses.exPt: A mudança mais marcante é a nova câmera.

senses.def: a short written message
senses.ex: I left a note for you on the fridge.
senses.exPt: Deixei um bilhete para você na geladeira.

senses.def: something you write down to help you remember
senses.ex: I always take notes in class.
senses.exPt: Eu sempre faço anotações na aula.

senses.def: to write something down so you remember it
senses.ex: Let me note down your phone number.
senses.exPt: Deixa eu anotar o seu número de telefone.

senses.def: a book with empty pages for writing in
senses.ex: Write the new words in your notebook.
senses.exPt: Escreva as palavras novas no seu caderno.

senses.def: not anything
senses.ex: There's nothing in the fridge, let's order a pizza.
senses.exPt: Não tem nada na geladeira, vamos pedir uma pizza.

senses.def: to see or become aware of something
senses.ex: Did you notice that she cut her hair?
senses.exPt: Você percebeu que ela cortou o cabelo?

senses.def: a piece of paper with information, put where people can see it
senses.ex: There's a notice on the door saying the shop is closed.
senses.exPt: Há um aviso na porta dizendo que a loja está fechada.

senses.def: information that something will happen, given before it happens
senses.ex: You need to give a month's notice before you leave the flat.
senses.exPt: Você precisa avisar com um mês de antecedência antes de sair do apartamento.

senses.def: easy to see or notice
senses.ex: There's been a noticeable improvement in your English.
senses.exPt: Houve uma melhora visível no seu inglês.

senses.def: a board on a wall where notices are put
senses.ex: The exam results are on the noticeboard.
senses.exPt: Os resultados das provas estão no quadro de avisos.

senses.def: an idea or belief about something
senses.ex: The notion that money brings happiness is wrong.
senses.exPt: A ideia de que dinheiro traz felicidade está errada.

senses.def: famous for something bad
senses.ex: This bar is notorious for fights, so we never go there.
senses.exPt: Esse bar é conhecido pelas brigas, então a gente nunca vai lá.

senses.def: despite something
senses.ex: Notwithstanding the bad weather, the event was a great success.
senses.exPt: Apesar do mau tempo, o evento foi um grande sucesso.

senses.def: the number 0
senses.ex: Write the number one followed by six noughts.
senses.exPt: Escreva o número um seguido de seis zeros.

senses.def: a word that is the name of a person, place or thing
senses.ex: 'Table' and 'happiness' are both nouns.
senses.exPt: 'Table' e 'happiness' são substantivos.

senses.def: to give a person, animal or plant the food it needs to grow and be healthy
senses.ex: Healthy food nourishes both the body and the mind.
senses.exPt: Comida saudável nutre tanto o corpo quanto a mente.

senses.def: the food that people, animals and plants need to live and grow
senses.ex: Babies need proper nourishment to grow strong.
senses.exPt: Os bebês precisam de uma alimentação adequada para crescerem fortes.

senses.def: a long written story about imaginary people and events
senses.ex: She is reading a novel by a famous French writer.
senses.exPt: Ela está lendo um romance de um escritor francês famoso.

senses.def: a person who writes novels
senses.ex: She's a famous novelist who has written twenty books.
senses.exPt: Ela é uma romancista famosa que escreveu vinte livros.

senses.def: the quality of being new and unusual, or something new
senses.ex: Working from home was a novelty at first, but now it's normal.
senses.exPt: Trabalhar de casa era uma novidade no começo, mas agora é normal.

senses.def: the eleventh month of the year
senses.ex: My son was born in November.
senses.exPt: Meu filho nasceu em novembro.

senses.def: at the present time
senses.ex: I'm busy now. Can I call you later?
senses.exPt: Estou ocupado agora. Posso te ligar mais tarde?

senses.def: at the present time, compared with the past
senses.ex: Most young people nowadays shop online.
senses.exPt: A maioria dos jovens hoje em dia compra pela internet.

senses.def: not in or to any place
senses.ex: There's nowhere to park near the office.
senses.exPt: Não tem lugar nenhum para estacionar perto do escritório.

senses.def: using the energy made by splitting atoms
senses.ex: The country has two nuclear power stations.
senses.exPt: O país tem duas usinas nucleares.

senses.def: the central part of an atom or cell
senses.ex: The nucleus is the centre of an atom.
senses.exPt: O núcleo é o centro de um átomo.

senses.def: something or someone that annoys you or causes problems
senses.ex: The noise from the building site is a real nuisance.
senses.exPt: O barulho da obra é um verdadeiro incômodo.

senses.def: unable to feel anything in a part of your body
senses.ex: My fingers were numb with cold after the long walk.
senses.exPt: Meus dedos estavam dormentes de frio depois da longa caminhada.

senses.def: unable to think or feel emotions because of shock
senses.ex: She felt completely numb after hearing the news.
senses.exPt: Ela ficou completamente sem reação depois de ouvir a notícia.

senses.def: to make a part of the body unable to feel anything
senses.ex: The dentist numbed my mouth before pulling the tooth.
senses.exPt: O dentista anestesiou minha boca antes de arrancar o dente.

senses.def: a word or symbol like 1, 2 or 3
senses.ex: My house number is twenty-five.
senses.exPt: O número da minha casa é vinte e cinco.

senses.def: using or expressed in numbers
senses.ex: The files are arranged in numerical order.
senses.exPt: Os arquivos estão organizados em ordem numérica.

senses.def: many
senses.ex: I've tried to call her numerous times.
senses.exPt: Já tentei ligar para ela inúmeras vezes.

senses.def: a person who takes care of sick people in a hospital
senses.ex: My sister is a nurse at the city hospital.
senses.exPt: Minha irmã é enfermeira no hospital da cidade.

senses.def: a place where young children are looked after
senses.ex: She takes her son to nursery every morning.
senses.exPt: Ela leva o filho para a creche todas as manhãs.

senses.def: a room in a house for a baby
senses.ex: They painted the nursery blue before the baby was born.
senses.exPt: Eles pintaram o quarto do bebê de azul antes de ele nascer.

senses.def: a place where plants are grown to be sold
senses.ex: We bought these plants at a local nursery.
senses.exPt: Compramos estas plantas num viveiro aqui perto.

senses.def: a dry fruit with a hard shell and a part inside you can eat
senses.ex: I can't eat this cake because I'm allergic to nuts.
senses.exPt: Não posso comer este bolo porque sou alérgico a castanhas.

senses.def: a small piece of metal with a hole that screws onto a bolt
senses.ex: Use a spanner to tighten the nut on the wheel.
senses.exPt: Use uma chave inglesa para apertar a porca da roda.

senses.def: a substance in food that living things need to grow
senses.ex: Vegetables are full of important nutrients.
senses.exPt: Os legumes são cheios de nutrientes importantes.

senses.def: the food you eat and how it affects your health
senses.ex: Good nutrition is essential for growing children.
senses.exPt: Uma boa alimentação é essencial para crianças em fase de crescimento.

senses.def: full of the things your body needs to stay healthy
senses.ex: Fresh vegetables are cheap and very nutritious.
senses.exPt: Verduras frescas são baratas e muito nutritivas.

senses.def: in a nutshell: said in a very short and clear way
senses.ex: In a nutshell, the project failed because of money.
senses.exPt: Resumindo, o projeto fracassou por falta de dinheiro.
